Container.Name: dymo-cups
Container.Overview: DYMO CUPS Docker for Unraid - Share DYMO LabelWriter printer over LAN using CUPS. Features automatic USB device detection - no manual configuration needed! Works across reboots. This container provides network printing capabilities for DYMO label printers in an Unraid environment.
